criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One goldenHour desert on every frame, 1, 5 and 9 strong. Frames 7 and 8 a flat stage with cardboard panels and little shadow, frame 4 near orthographic with a floating slab, the genset models simple.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one hero, one accent, both devices carried, the fence measured at 229.5 of 918 px. Frame 5 slightly outside, frame 1's rule blurs the accent's meaning.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, frame 4's bar ends at 366 of 1,000, frame 5's lines verbatim, the sources block lists every id. Frame 7's accent carries a reading beyond c23's capital costs, frame 3 drops c21's 'initially', 'told KVIA' is looser than c48's published statement, c46 rests on KVIA, frame 8's label drops the exception.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: County, bodies, decision, date and a concrete stake named. The reader's action implied.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, the 7 to 8 swipe lands, 9 closes. 3 could fold into 2.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and passes every house rule, sharp hooks. Several deks paraphrase the PFD, regional texture only in the art.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat. Gas engines for a data center as no. 32, the PUCT Interchange as no. 36.

one_sentence_fix: Make the granite accent mean only what each frame's claim supports and label it: capital costs on frame 7, c30's scope with its exception on frame 8, no decorative rule on frame 1, and 'initially' restored to islanded on frame 3.
